lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.unitTitle: Kitchen Care and Basic Food Safety
lessonRef.title: Mastery check: simple no-heat preparation

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice simple no-heat preparation. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: Without being told the exact steps, the learner is given (or selects) a short list of no-heat ingredients and independently plans and assembles one finished food item that meets three criteria: uses at least three ingredients, is assembled in a logical order, and is served in a way that's ready to eat.
safetyNotes: No heat source is used in this lesson by design; any knife used for soft, no-heat ingredients is adult-approved beforehand.

simulationAlternative.description: If the specific ingredients aren't available at home, the learner instead plans the full sequence in writing for a no-heat food item using ingredients they do have or a provided list, describing each assembly step in the order they would do it, in place of physically assembling it.

materials: adult-or-local: a knife appropriate for the ingredients (adult-approved if needed)

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Rate your confidence in assembling a no-heat food item on your own (very / somewhat / not yet), cite one specific step from today as evidence, and choose: ready to try a food item with more steps, ready to review this again, or need a different explanation.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Ingredient use and logic: At least three ingredients, assembled in a logical order. | Finished-and-ready quality: Item is fully assembled and ready to eat. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Plan and assemble a second no-heat food item that meets a new constraint (uses one ingredient the learner has never used before, or serves two people instead of one).

duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

resources.title: simple no-heat preparation worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Without being told the exact steps, the learner is given (or selects) a short list of no-heat ingredients and independently plans and assembles one finished food item that meets three criteria: uses at least three ingredients, is assembled in a logical order, and is served in a way that's ready to eat.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact simple no-heat preparation decision or action.
Model move 2: Quickly recall: name two no-heat foods you already know how to put together without help.
Model move 3: Plan and assemble one no-heat food item using at least three ingredients, in a logical order, served ready to eat.
Model check: Ingredient use and logic: At least three ingredients, assembled in a logical order. | Finished-and-ready quality: Item is fully assembled and ready to eat.

resources.title: simple no-heat preparation action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for simple no-heat preparation.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: simple no-heat preparation coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Without being told the exact steps, the learner is given (or selects) a short list of no-heat ingredients and independently plans and assembles one finished food item that meets three criteria: uses at least three ingredients, is assembled in a logical order, and is served in a way that's ready to eat.
Coach direction: Quickly recall: name two no-heat foods you already know how to put together without help.
Learner prompt: Name the two foods.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: simple no-heat preparation complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Plan and assemble one no-heat food item using at least three ingredients, in a logical order, served ready to eat.
Response 1 (t2-p1): List the ingredients you used and the order you assembled them in.
Response 2 (t2-p2): My finished item uses at least three ingredients.
Response 3 (t2-p3): My finished item is served in a way that's actually ready to eat (not still in pieces on the counter).

Equal-access rule: If the specific ingredients aren't available at home, the learner instead plans the full sequence in writing for a no-heat food item using ingredients they do have or a provided list, describing each assembly step in the order they would do it, in place of physically assembling it.

resources.title: simple no-heat preparation minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.

Reflection: Rate your confidence in assembling a no-heat food item on your own (very / somewhat / not yet), cite one specific step from today as evidence, and choose: ready to try a food item with more steps, ready to review this again, or need a different explanation.
Success checks: Ingredient use and logic: At least three ingredients, assembled in a logical order. | Finished-and-ready quality: Item is fully assembled and ready to eat.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: simple no-heat preparation supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional simple no-heat preparation condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Ingredient use and logic: At least three ingredients, assembled in a logical order. | Finished-and-ready quality: Item is fully assembled and ready to eat..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u03-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
